title: gelasia lanata
intro: Gelasia lanata, commonly known as Velvet Flower, is a flowering plant species that belongs to the family Asteraceae. The health benefits of Gelasia lanata include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which make it useful in treating various health conditions such as wounds, skin infections, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to soothe and calm the skin, reduce inflammation, and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Gelasia lanata include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
